info.title: OPEX Partner API
info.description:
Read the website content you are granted and propose changes as change requests; OPEX's policy engine and operators decide.

**Sign-in.** OAuth 2.1: authorization code with PKCE for AraCMS staff (they sign in on OPEX, never in AraCMS), or client credentials for the AraCMS server itself. Clients authenticate with `private_key_jwt` (ES256). Every access token is DPoP-bound: send `Authorization: DPoP <token>` and a fresh `DPoP` proof on each request.

**Writes** (uploads, change requests, withdraw, resubmit, previews) also need an `Idempotency-Key` and an RFC 9421 HTTP message signature (alg ecdsa-p256-sha256) covering `@method`, `@path`, `idempotency-key`, `content-digest` (with a body) and `x-end-user-ip` (when sent), created within ±60 s, with a single-use nonce. The PHP reference client (clients/php-reference) does all of this.

**Webhooks** tell you when your change requests move and when content is published; verify `OPEX-Signature` on the raw body.

**Errors** are RFC 9457 `application/problem+json` with a stable `code` (the OAuth token endpoint uses RFC 6749 errors instead). Validation errors list `issues` (path + message). Every answer carries `X-Request-Id`; quote it when reporting a problem.

**Rate limits** default to 600 requests per minute per IP; routes that differ say so. Over the limit: 429 `RATE_LIMITED` with `Retry-After`.

**Timestamps** are ISO 8601 UTC. **Ids** are prefixed ULIDs (`cr_`, `ast_`, `rev_`, `tkt_`…): sortable by creation time.

get.summary: Sign-in page for AraCMS staff (start of the authorization code flow)
get.description:
AraCMS redirects the user here; the user signs in with their OPEX partner account (password, then authenticator code) and is sent back to `redirect_uri` with `code` and `state`.

**Rate limit:** 30 per minute per IP.

**Source:** `apps/opex-api/src/oauth/routes.ts`

parameters.name: redirect_uri
parameters.description: Must exactly match a registered redirect URI.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Returned unchanged on the redirect; use it against CSRF.

parameters.name: scope
parameters.description: Space-separated: content:read content:propose media:upload cr:read cr:withdraw

400.description:
`VALIDATION_FAILED`: The request does not match the schema; `issues` lists each field.

`INVALID_REQUEST`: Missing or malformed parameters.

`INVALID_CLIENT`: Unknown client, or redirect_uri not registered.

429.description: `RATE_LIMITED`: More than 30 per minute per IP.

post.summary: Sign-in form steps (password, then authenticator code)
post.description:
Posted by the sign-in page itself (`stage` = password | code). On success: 303 to `redirect_uri?code=…&state=…`.

**Rate limit:** 10 per minute per IP.

**Audit:** records `oauth.login.success`, `oauth.login.failure`, `oauth.mfa.failure`.

**Source:** `apps/opex-api/src/oauth/routes.ts`

state.description: Returned unchanged on the redirect; use it against CSRF.

scope.description: Space-separated: content:read content:propose media:upload cr:read cr:withdraw

post.description:
Answers 200 with `{}` for unknown clients and unknown tokens (no token probing). A known client must authenticate (private_key_jwt).

**Audit:** records `oauth.token.revoked`.

**Source:** `apps/opex-api/src/oauth/routes.ts`

post.description:
Client authentication is private_key_jwt only (`client_assertion_type=urn:ietf:params:oauth:client-assertion-type:jwt-bearer`, ES256, aud = this URL, single-use jti). Every request needs a `DPoP` proof header; tokens are bound to that key. Errors follow RFC 6749 (`error`, `error_description`), not problem+json.

**Rate limit:** 60 per minute per IP.

**Audit:** records `oauth.token.issued`, `oauth.token.refreshed`, `oauth.token.failure`, `oauth.refresh.reuse_detected`.

**Source:** `apps/opex-api/src/oauth/routes.ts`

parameters.name: DPoP
parameters.description: DPoP proof for POST to this URL.

redirect_uri.description: authorization_code: the same URI as in /oauth/authorize

scope.description: client_credentials: space-separated; limited to the client's scopes

access_token.description: JWT (ES256), bound to the DPoP key (cnf.jkt).

refresh_token.description: Single use; rotated on every refresh. Presenting a used one revokes the whole session.

400.description: invalid_client, invalid_grant (bad/expired/reused code, PKCE mismatch, refresh reuse — which revokes the session), invalid_dpop_proof, unauthorized_client, unsupported_grant_type.

403.description: access_denied: the call is not from the client's allowed network.

429.description: `RATE_LIMITED`: More than 60 per minute per IP.

post.summary: Propose changes (the policy engine decides at once)
post.description:
Every item is checked against your grants and the schema. The policy engine then auto-approves (and may publish), sends to review, or denies. Watch `cr.state_changed` webhooks or poll GET /v1/partner/change-requests/{id}.

**Signed write:** Idempotency-Key and an RFC 9421 HTTP message signature are required (see the partner guide).

**Rate limit:** 300 per hour per IP.

**Audit:** records `cr.submitted`, `cr.policy_decision`, `cr.approved`, `cr.published`, `cr.rejected`.

**Source:** `apps/opex-api/src/partner/routes.ts`

400.description:
`VALIDATION_FAILED`: The request does not match the schema; `issues` lists each field.

`IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REQUIRED`: No Idempotency-Key header.

`PATH_NOT_FOUND`: An item path does not exist in the draft.

`UNKNOWN_ASSET`: A value names an asset that is not yours and not public.

`BAD_BASE_REVISION`: A base_revision_id does not belong to the item's entry.

`VALUE_REQUIRED`: A set or insert item has no value.

401.description: `UNAUTHENTICATED`: Missing, expired or revoked access token, or a bad DPoP proof. Or: Bad request signature (`detail` says why): missing or malformed, not covering the required components, wrong alg, `created` outside ±60 s, content digest mismatch, unknown keyid, does not verify, or a replayed nonce.

403.description:
`SCOPE_DENIED`: The token lacks the scope this route needs.

`NETWORK_DENIED`: The call does not come from the partner's allowed network (or mTLS certificate, when configured).

`GRANT_DENIED`: An item touches a field, locale or action you have no grant for.

`FIELD_LOCKED`: An item touches a locked or operator-only field.

404.description: `NOT_FOUND`: Unknown content type in an item.

409.description: `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED`: The same Idempotency-Key with a different request.

429.description: `RATE_LIMITED`: More than 300 per hour per IP.

post.description:
Raster images are re-encoded to WebP (metadata stripped); SVG and PDF are checked for active content; everything is virus-scanned. Use the returned `asset` id in a change request value. Max 25 MB.

**Signed write:** Idempotency-Key and an RFC 9421 HTTP message signature are required (see the partner guide).

**Rate limit:** 120 uploads per hour per IP.

**Audit:** records `media.upload`, `media.rejected`.

**Source:** `apps/opex-api/src/partner/routes.ts`

get.summary: Content types and fields you may read and propose
get.description:
AraCMS builds its edit forms from this: `schema` is what the caller may read, `proposable` what it may change (both projected to the caller's grants). Locked and operator-only fields are never proposable.

**Source:** `apps/opex-api/src/partner/routes.ts`

post.description: Sent to the partner client's webhook URL when one of its change requests moves (auto-approved, approved, published, rejected, needs_rebase, expired…). Secret: the partner's webhook secret.

parameters.name: OPEX-Signature
parameters.description: t=<unix seconds>, v1=<hex HMAC-SHA256(secret, t + '.' + raw body)>

id.description: Event id (evt_…); unique, use it to drop duplicates.

conflicts.description: With needs_rebase: what changed under your items.

2XX.description: Received. Anything else is retried with backoff (at least once).

post.description: Sent to every active partner with a webhook URL when content is published, so a partner can refresh what it shows.

parameters.name: OPEX-Signature
parameters.description: t=<unix seconds>, v1=<hex HMAC-SHA256(secret, t + '.' + raw body)>

id.description: Event id (evt_…); unique, use it to drop duplicates.

anyOf.description: A form was published, archived or restored.
Refresh everything (CLI site:revalidate after a deploy or restore).

2XX.description: Received. Anything else is retried with backoff (at least once).

client.description: OAuth client authentication: `client_assertion` (private_key_jwt, ES256) in the form body.

partner.description: `Authorization: DPoP <access token>` plus a `DPoP` proof JWT (htm, htu, ath, fresh jti) on every request. Tokens come from POST /oauth/token (private_key_jwt + PKCE).

opexSignature.name: OPEX-Signature
opexSignature.description: Webhooks OPEX sends: t=<unix seconds>, v1=<hex HMAC-SHA256(secret, t + '.' + raw body)>. Verify it, reject t older than 5 minutes, and drop repeated event ids.

base_revision_id.description: The draft revision you read (GET /v1/partner/content/{type} → base_revision_id).

path.description: Field path; list items by key [id=…] or index [n], e.g. /tech/items[id=flexo]/summary

locale.description: For localized text: the one language this item changes.

op.description: insert appends to the list at path (grant entry.create); remove deletes the item (grant entry.delete).

value.description: New value. Images: { asset: 'ast_…', alt?: {fa,en,tr} } with an id from POST /v1/partner/media.

error.description: invalid_client | invalid_grant | invalid_dpop_proof | unauthorized_client | unsupported_grant_type | access_denied

policy.description: The policy that decided (null: the default).

code.description: Stable machine code, e.g. VALIDATION_FAILED, CONFLICT_BASE_REVISION.

instance.description: The request id (also in the X-Request-Id header).

issues.description: Field problems, for VALIDATION_FAILED and form submissions.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: A UUID per logical write. The same key and body replay the first answer (`Idempotent-Replayed: true`); the same key with another body is refused (409 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED). Kept 24 hours.

SignatureInput.name: Signature-Input
SignatureInput.description: RFC 9421, label `sig1`, alg `ecdsa-p256-sha256`, covering `"@method" "@path" "idempotency-key"`, plus `"content-digest"` with a body and `"x-end-user-ip"` when sent; `created` within ±60 s; single-use `nonce`; `keyid` = your client key id.

Signature.name: Signature
Signature.description: RFC 9421 signature `sig1=:<base64>:` over the signature base.

EndUserIp.name: X-End-User-IP
EndUserIp.description: The AraCMS user's IP, recorded in the audit log. Must be covered by the signature when sent.

DPoP.name: DPoP
DPoP.description: DPoP proof JWT (RFC 9449) for this request: htm, htu, iat, jti, ath (hash of the access token), signed with the key the token is bound to.
